what: IDACORP owns Idaho Power, the regulated electricity utility serving southern Idaho and eastern Oregon, with a generation mix built around hydroelectric dams on the Snake River.
customers: Households and businesses in southern Idaho and eastern Oregon, who have no alternative supplier.
moat: A legal monopoly in one of the fastest-growing states in America, with hydroelectric generation that costs almost nothing to run once built.
risks: Free cash flow is negative by $1.0B as the network is expanded to serve new customers
Drought reduces hydroelectric output and forces the utility to buy power instead
opportunities: A 17.8% net margin guaranteed by the regulated return
Idaho is among the fastest-growing states, so the customer base keeps expanding
Analysts see about 9% upside, and every dollar invested in the network earns a regulated return
watch: Customer growth and the outcome of Idaho rate cases.
